steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const state = rt.getEngineState(); if (state.lastMessageId !== 1 || state.blackboard.values.lit_lamp !== true) throw new Error(`the two lines were not consumed: last=${state.lastMessageId} values=${JSON.stringify(state.blackboard.values)}`); for (let i = 0; i < 120 && rt.getSnapshot().saveHealth?.pendingBoundary != null; i += 1) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); const health = rt.getSnapshot().saveHealth; if (health?.pendingBoundary != null) throw new Error(`the last boundary is not saved yet, so a reload would legitimately diverge: ${JSON.stringify(health)}`); globalThis.__v24Reload = { epoch: rt.getRunContext().sessionEpoch, chatId: ctx.chatId, integrity: ctx.chatMetadata?.integrity ?? null, boundary: state.boundary }; return globalThis.__v24Reload;

const seen = []; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const handler = (id) => seen.push(id); ctx.eventSource.on(ctx.eventTypes.CHAT_CHANGED, handler); try { await ctx.reloadCurrentChat(); } finally { ctx.eventSource.removeListener(ctx.eventTypes.CHAT_CHANGED, handler); } const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; for (let i = 0; i < 100 && !rt.getSnapshot().storyId; i += 1) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); const now = SillyTavern.getContext(); if (now.chatId !== globalThis.__v24Reload.chatId) throw new Error(`the reload moved the page to ${now.chatId}`); if (!seen.length || seen.some((id) => id !== globalThis.__v24Reload.chatId)) throw new Error(`H9: expected CHAT_CHANGED with the same id, saw ${JSON.stringify(seen)}`); return { chatChanged: seen, integrity: now.chatMetadata?.integrity ?? null, sameIntegrity: (now.chatMetadata?.integrity ?? null) === globalThis.__v24Reload.integrity };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const now = rt.getRunContext().sessionEpoch; if (now !== globalThis.__v24Reload.epoch) throw new Error(`a reload of the same chat was treated as a chat switch: the run epoch moved ${globalThis.__v24Reload.epoch} -> ${now} (plan 02 section 3)`); return { epoch: now };
